name: Crew Chief
author: Jeremy Longshore
description: See every running AI coding agent session in the Omarchy bar — Claude Code, Codex, Goose, Kilo, pi, any harness — and get alerted the moment one is blocked waiting on your input.

barWidget.description: Bar pill counts running agent sessions and turns loud when one needs your input or finished its run. The panel lists every session with project, harness, state, and age — attention first. Ships adapters for Claude Code and Codex plus a one-command reporter for any other tool.

schema.label: Sync sessions from Herdr (when installed)
schema.description: When Herdr is installed, every agent pane it detects joins the fleet automatically — no hooks needed. Harmless no-op without Herdr.
